title: Saved Replies Feature Documentation First
purpose: Validate that fragmented feature requests become a doc-first control record before implementation.
expectedFinalIntent: Define a spec for saved chat replies with storage ownership and decision criteria, while deferring implementation.

userFragments.content: I want a saved replies feature in chat.
Don't build it yet. First write the doc and make it explain where saved replies live.
Maybe it should be Pod-backed, unless that complicates things, then just document the decision path.

secretaryReplies.content: Classified as a new chat capability concern. I will bind it to a control record before any worker dispatch.
Scope updated to documentation-first. Implementation remains deferred until the storage ownership decision is explicit.
The control record now captures Pod-backed storage as a decision path, not as an implementation commitment.

requiredPhrases: No Issue, Task, Delivery, or worker run should start yet
